title: Claim a kill's visible cubes while only one distant enemy (>= 100 m) watches (CLAIM_WATCHED_ON)
behaviors: after our kill, the Build 14 collect walk may start/continue toward a cube we can see within CLAIM_M of the death spot when exactly one enemy has line of sight to us and it is at least params.gunRange (100 m) away, our HP is at least 50% of max, t >= 10 s and no supply drop is listed; every other claim gate (in zone, not leaving, no engage, zone-safe, no mech hit in 2 s, CLAIM_S window) is unchanged
next_action: Grok: assign or park. If built: one flag CLAIM_WATCHED_ON default false, flag-0 eqdrive identical, check.py < 30 ms, base-0 hazard with fired/diff/score, deaths within 10 s of activation, cubes at end.
single_decision: Relax one condition of the existing claim gate: 'nobody has LOS to us' becomes 'nobody has LOS to us, OR (flag on) exactly one enemy has LOS and it is >= 100 m away, HP >= 50%, a cube is visible near the death spot, t >= 10 s, obs.drops empty'. No new walk target, no new mode; the walk is the champion's 'engage, collect'.
trigger: claim active (our kill in the last CLAIM_S = 12 s) AND me.in_zone AND !leaveNow AND !engage AND a cube in obs.cubes within CLAIM_M (12 m) of the death spot AND zone-safe AND obs.t - lastMechHit > 2 s AND seenAt(cone=false) is true for exactly one threat, at flat distance >= 100 m AND me.hp >= 0.5 * max_hp AND obs.t >= 10 AND obs.drops.length === 0
hook: brain.ts act(), Build 14 collect block brain.ts:657-670; the gate is the else-if at brain.ts:669 (`zoneSafe && obs.t - lastMechHit > THREAT_HIT_S && !seenAt(me.pos, myHeight, threats, false)`). Add the guarded alternative there; `cube` (brain.ts:663) must be defined for the relaxed case. Ordering is unchanged: the claimGoal branch (brain.ts:791) already ranks below zone/engage/retreat and above laser rush (794), crossfire (798), ambush (805), drop (815/818) and heal (821). Drop run is computed with !claimGoal (brain.ts:727), hence the obs.drops gate. Flag in params.ts next to ENGAGE_ON.
gates: Cannot start before t = 10 s (explicit obs.t >= 10). Never starts while any supply drop is listed in obs.drops (called and not yet taken; protocol.md:359 every mech sees it from the moment it is called), so it never runs while a drop is announced/active and can never displace drop run/hold (those need a listed drop). Off = champion exactly (flag false short-circuits).

evidence.sim_trigger_state: Champion claim blocked only by LOS with a visible cube near the kill: 158/192 games (13,030 decisions). Spec slice (t >= 10, no drop listed, HP >= 50%, <= 1 LOS enemy at >= 100 m, cube visible): 132 episodes in 65/192 games; LOS enemy median 160 m (p10 113 m); our HP median 0.77; episode median 2.4 s (p90 7.4 s); alive median 14 (p10 12), t median 33.7 s (p10 14.3, p90 56.7) (distance/HP/time figures from the 139-episode, 66-game slice before the <= 1 LOS filter).
evidence.sim_cost_of_waiting: In those episodes the champion (standing/healing instead of collecting) still lost a median 3% of max HP in the next 5 s (p90 19%): the single far watcher shoots anyway. It collected later within the 12 s window in 89/132 episodes and never in 43/132 (37/192 games). Mode when blocked (pre-LOS-count slice, 139 eps): heal 61, hold 28, heal hiding 26, laser rush 14, break crossfire 6 (excluded by the <= 1 LOS gate), hide 4.
evidence.sim_context: Kills per game 3.33; 186/192 games have at least one kill; mean cubes at end 2.59.
evidence.protocol: Killed mechs drop all their cubes plus two (protocol.md:426); each cube +4% max HP (healing the difference) and +4% damage to 10 (protocol.md:425).
evidence.watcher: Cubes held at 2-4 alive 16.50 vs 9.34 (RANKED.md rule 2, d=0.65, 5281/3133 ticks, 51/47 matches); mid-phase pickup rate 5.11 vs 3.12 cubes/min (SKILLS.md, 6231/5574 s, 54/56 matches).
evidence.showdown_first_fights: PR #145 coord/research-doug-1941.md (branch research-doug-20261122-0041, not on main): first fight with more cubes KILL/DIED 166/74 (n=485) vs fewer cubes 100/220 (n=631).
evidence.site: Both site tests that reduced claiming lost: B53 POST_KILL_COVER_ON (cover after an early kill) 3.50 vs 3.67 (-0.17); B94 LATE_CLAIM_ON (late walk outranks cube claim) 3.73 vs 3.79 (-0.06) (coord/data/site_results.csv). No test has widened the claim.

estimated_activation: ~65/192 games on 2000+3000 (132 trigger episodes, champion code + passive sim log). Each activation changes movement, so diff_behavior should be close to fired. Held-out set not measured.
closest_prior_test: B53 POST_KILL_COVER_ON (opposite direction: take cover after a kill, LOSS -0.17) and B94 LATE_CLAIM_ON (claim demoted below the late walk, -0.06). PR #145 ranked build 3 'take the kill's laser' (not built) would reuse the same claim walk for a dropped laser; P36 changes only who may watch, not what is collected, so the two must not be stacked in one build.
what_would_disprove: Paired screen: mech damage taken during relaxed-claim walks larger than the champion's 5 s loss in the same state (median 3%, p90 19% of max), or deaths within 10 s of a relaxed claim higher than the champion; cubes at death/end not higher; diff_score worse on both sets; fewer than 10/192 games fired.
risks: Pins: none new (same 'engage, collect' walk to a visible cube within 12 m of the death spot, CLAIM_S 12 s cap, claim cleared at the spot); builder still lists every 20 s+ pin vs main. Drops: gated on obs.drops empty, so claim never pre-empts a drop run/hold (brain.ts:727 uses !claimGoal). Exposure: one watcher at >= 100 m with a gun (hit-rate guess 0.5 beyond 60 m, brain.ts:98) or a laser (280 m reach, no spread) can punish the walk; a second enemy turning up ends the relaxed case (LOS count must be exactly 1). Displaces stand-still heal and 'heal, hiding' for at most a few seconds (walking does not stop regen, protocol.md:291). Pre-empts the laser rush as the champion's claim already does.
